_: The 241 Doré plates, each resolved to the verse it depicts.
THIS FILE IS THE DECISION, not a cache of one. It was produced once, on
2026-08-28, by a reconciliation that read the caption printed under each
plate with OCR and voted it against the Wikipedia table and
catholic-resources.org's own index; that code has been deleted, because a
vote whose result is written down here has nothing left to decide. Its
evidence did not go with it: every reading is kept below, whether it won
or lost, so a disagreement can still be argued from what was actually
read. See git history for the machinery, and docs/decisions.md.
WHY IT IS TRACKED HERE rather than in the corpus. `build/` is untracked
and regenerates from `raw/`; this does not regenerate from anything. OCR
is not a pure function of a file -- a different tesseract build reads a
digit differently -- so re-deriving these would have been a re-decision
wearing a rebuild's clothes, with no diff anywhere to show it. It sits
beside absent-sources.json and translations-checked.json, which are the
project's other two records of knowledge derived where there is no page
for it to sit beside (CLAUDE.md, 'The corpus').
TO CHANGE AN ANCHOR, edit it here and say why in the commit. A plate
whose verse is wrong is a one-line fix; there is no pipeline to re-run.

witnesses.caption: The caption printed under the plate in the Dover reproduction, read by OCR. Preferred for the verse: it is the plate's own statement of what it depicts.
witnesses.wikipedia: en.wikipedia.org's table of the Doré Bible illustrations, paired to a plate by caption title rather than by number -- the two indexes number the set differently.
witnesses.index: catholic-resources.org's own index page, which names a book and chapter but no verse.
